From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation roadmap & acceptance schedule — week 1 status

Jordan / Priya —

Quick week‑1 MAP checkpoint and asks before our Wed exec sync: attached is MAP_Acme_v1.3.xlsx and a first draft of acceptance criteria (eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf). Highlights from this sprint: 

- Completed: model access to staging cluster, baseline inference throughput tests (p95 latency ~120ms on short sequences).
- In progress: scripted end‑to‑end eval harness (owner: Marissa); sample production traffic replay is 40% complete.
- Blocker: production sample dataset missing 2 PII fields required by your validation team — holding acceptance gating for data completeness.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Jordan: confirm whether procurement can expedite the DPA addendum for logging access (ETA: Tue 12/1)
- Marissa: deliver first eval harness run and summary (ETA: Wed 12/2)
- Rishi: prepare temporary scoped token for Acme staging (ETA: Mon 11/30 EOD) — addresses data access blocker

Ask: Can your validation team sign off on the minimal acceptance subset (10k records) while we complete the full replay? That would keep the trial window intact and allow a canary acceptance.

Proposed next sync: Wed 12/2 10:00am PT (30m) — agenda: harness results, acceptance checklist, procurement status.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0122

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.3.xlsx (workbook), eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf (doc)

Thanks Aditya — good progress. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Acceptance subset: our validation team is OK with a 10k record minimal set, but we need a documented acceptance runbook (steps + exact metrics) before they start the test. Can Marissa share that?
2) Data fields: the two missing PII fields are customer_contact.phone and customer_verified. We can provide a redacted feed if that works for logging.
3) Procurement: I'll follow up with procurement today but need the specific DPA clause language you referenced so they can expedite.

If we can get the runbook and a temporary scoped token by EOD Tue we can still hit your proposed acceptance window.

On the meeting: Wed 12/2 10am PT works for me.

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director, Platform Integrations | AcmeCorp
jordan.ellis@acmecorp.com

Jordan / team —

See inline and attached: I updated eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf with a concrete runbook and pass/fail thresholds. Attached is a short CSV of the 10k minimal subset we'll use for the canary run. Summary: 

- Acceptance runbook (attached): exact commands, post‑run checks, and tolerance thresholds. Key metrics: exact match rate for entity extraction >= 92%, end‑to‑end latency p95 <= 250ms for 2k token window, and no PII leakage in outputs.
- Owner assignments:
  - Runbook & harness execution: Marissa Cole — will run first canary on Wed 12/2 and share logs by EOD.
  - Data redaction and sample prep: Jordan / Acme validation team — provide redacted 10k subset by Tue 12/1 5pm PT.
  - Token & staging access: Rishi Malhotra — will create scoped token with logging access limited to test headers by Tue 12/1 EOD.
  - Procurement & DPA wording: Aditya — provide clause excerpt for procurement review (Aditya: can you paste the DPA paragraph here?).
- Blocker mitigation: if the redacted feed is delayed, Marissa can run a synthetic canonical feed that mimics your schema to exercise the harness; results will be marked as "synthetic" in the report.

I attached: eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf (v1.1 runbook) and MAP_Acme_v1.3.xlsx (updated timeline tab).

I'll run the harness Wed morning and post logs to the shared Drive link.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation roadmap & acceptance schedule — week 1 status (minutes & next steps)

Jordan / Priya / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Follow up from this week's runs and our Wed sync: 

- Marissa completed the first canary harness on Wed — results posted to the Drive link (summary below). The synthetic run produced a pass on latency but partial pass on entity extraction (91.4% vs 92% threshold) — full replay will likely reach threshold once additional context arrives.
- Rishi provisioned scoped token and we validated logging headers are limited to test metadata only.
- Procurement: Jordan confirmed DPA intake has started; Aditya has pasted the clause below for their review.

Attached: updated MAP_Acme_v1.3.xlsx (timeline revised), eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf (v1.2 with observed metrics), and harness logs (link in Drive).

DPA clause excerpt (for procurement): "Redwood agrees to process Customer Data only as instructed, to maintain industry-standard controls (SOC2), and to restrict access to logs to a scoped service account for the duration of the trial; retention of trial logs will be 30 days unless otherwise agreed."

Open items and owners (short list):
- Jordan / Acme validation: deliver redacted 10k sample or confirm synthetic run acceptable (owner: Jordan) — due Tue 12/8
- Marissa: run full production replay after sample received, post final acceptance report (owner: Marissa) — tentative due Fri 12/11
- Aditya: follow up on commercial timeline with procurement (owner: Aditya) — ongoing

Next sync: Tue 12/8 9:00am PT (15m standup) — focus: final acceptance decision and next commercial checkpoint.

If anything needs to be escalated to execs, flag me and I will loop in the AE manager.

Best,

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0122

summary: Week‑1 MAP checkpoint for Acme trial: staging access and first harness run completed; synthetic canary passed latency but narrowly missed entity extraction threshold. Action owners assigned for redacted sample, token, and procurement; next sync Tue 12/8.
